experiment1.interpretation: In the frozen iid toy model, hard minimum selection produces the predicted O(sqrt(h)) directional displacement while likelihood-weighted selection produces O(h) displacement. This does not by itself prove the same theorem for native NP, whose proposal semantics include incumbent reuse.

experiment2.interpretation: Exact-intermediate likelihood weighting can approach the correct posterior with increasing K, while hard selection and likelihood evaluated only at a denoised point can severely distort mode weights in ambiguous or near-ambiguous cases.

experiment3.interpretation: Fourier-magnitude symmetry explains several isolated DEV80 failures but does not explain the frozen common DAPS4/SITCOM4 failure subset; it is not the primary B25 follow-up.

verified_semantics.DAPS_main: nonnegative FFT-magnitude prediction with squared Gaussian residual against the supplied signed measurement
verified_semantics.DAPS_B20_auxiliary_LF_projection: uses abs(measurement) only inside the auxiliary amplitude projection
verified_semantics.SITCOM_main: nonnegative FFT-magnitude prediction with squared Gaussian residual against the supplied signed measurement
verified_semantics.NP_B24_DEV80: verifies the locked raw measurement, then uses measurement_raw.clamp_min(0.0) in the NP path

experiment4.interpretation_boundary: The preprocessing discrepancy is real and numerically nontrivial, but B25 does not prove that clipping alone caused any historical reconstruction failure.

final_recommendation: a precisely defined NP conditional-selection correction
